name: How long does a roof puncture assessment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a roof puncture assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a roof puncture assessment typically ranges from 30 minutes to a few hours, depending on the size and complexity of your roof and the extent of the damage. A small, easily accessible roof with minimal visible issues will take less time than a large, multi-level roof with suspected widespread damage. We aim to conduct thorough assessments efficiently to provide you with timely information.
acceptedAnswer.description: An assessment usually takes 30 minutes to a few hours, varying by roof size, complexity, and damage extent.
